task_description: Write a method in Dafny to reverse words seperated by spaces in a given string.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method ReverseWords(s: string) returns (v: string)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The output string contains the same words as the input string, but in reverse order
    - The sequence of words in the output string is the reverse of the sequence in the input string
    - The set of characters in the output string is the same as in the input string (including spaces), only reordered
    - The relative order of characters within each individual word remains unchanged
